purpose: Separate 3D starter physics cost from browser software-GPU rendering. No optimization or C-parity claim.
method: Three fresh-process runs per native/wasm mode, pinned to CPU 2, SLOPPY_THREADS=1. Program timer surrounds only 600 walk/step calls and periodic impulses. Setup, rendering and process startup are excluded; wasm JIT warmup during the measured loop is included. Default and release results match final-state checksum and player position.
limits: Small 18-candidate-crate yard, 5 static boxes and one character, 600 frames at dt=1/60. Not a dense physics stress test.
Reported times are elapsed program-clock observations under shared host load, not CPU-time or paired optimization measurements.
Browser rendering cost is excluded; browser SwiftShader slowness is not presented as hardware GPU performance.
